title: Binance Says bStocks Surpassed $1 Billion in Assets
why_it_matters: The milestone suggests that equity-linked tokens are attracting meaningful activity beyond market hours, while Binance's own disclosure also underlines the product's jurisdiction, eligibility and ownership limits.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Binance Says bStocks Surpassed $1 Billion in Assets

Binance says its bStocks tokenized-securities product passed $1 billion in assets about four months after launch, alongside more than $40 billion in reported cumulative volume.
